evals.prompt: I've been running a third-party vendor security review for our fintech for about six weeks across a bunch of sessions. We've gone through everything we have access to — SOC2 reports in `compliance/vendors/`, the questionnaire responses in `compliance/questionnaires/`, all the contract PDFs. What's left is basically: three vendors haven't sent their updated pen-test reports, our legal team hasn't confirmed the DPA status for two EU vendors, and Okta needs to give us the SSO audit log export. Every time I open a new session the context gets huge re-reading everything and I end up re-checking stuff I already checked. Can you turn this into something that just runs on its own and picks up when the missing docs show up?
evals.expected_output: Recognises the phase change (corpus exhausted, all gaps external), does NOT re-search, produces: an exhaustion enumeration of the compliance directories, a gap table with observable unblock conditions and named holders (vendors, legal, Okta), a rolling state file under 120 lines, a hardened GitHub Actions workflow with gate/iterate split + loop guard + self-termination, and a note in the project instructions that this is now a routine.
expectations: Produces a rolling state file (markdown) that is 120 lines or fewer
State file contains a status marker line on its own line whose value can be set to COMPLETE to stop the routine
State file contains a gap table where every row names the party who must act to unblock it (a third party or the project owner — never the routine/agent itself)
Every gap row's unblock condition is observable by the routine (a file path, env var, or repository signal), not 'when they reply'
Produces a CI workflow file (YAML) with a scheduled trigger AND at least one non-clock trigger (workflow_dispatch, push, or repository_dispatch)
Workflow has a cheap gate step that checks the status marker before any agent/iteration job runs
Workflow contains a loop guard: routine commits carry a marker and pushes carrying it are skipped
Commit message is read via env: and not interpolated into the run: script body (no ${{ github.event.head_commit.message }} inside run:)
Workflow YAML parses with a strict loader and has no duplicate keys
Iteration prompt tells the fresh session to read only the state file (plus recent log), not the project history, and to rewrite the state file last
Standing rules include 'passed/verified items are never re-checked' or equivalent 'never re-search exhausted material'
Project instructions (CLAUDE.md or equivalent) are updated to record that the work is now a routine and point at the state file
Response does NOT propose new searches of the corpus declared exhausted (re-checking held primaries in a verification queue is permitted, and must not contradict the standing rules)
Gap table lists the three pen-test reports, the two EU DPAs, and the Okta SSO export as separate rows with holders vendor / legal / Okta
Standing rules include a rule derived from the review-log's retracted 'datadog has no DPA' mistake (check contract appendices / primaries before negative findings)

A human push to the trigger paths actually leads to an iteration: either the agent action runs from push, or the gate relays the push into a repository_dispatch (not merely logging that push cannot iterate)
RESPONSE.md accurately describes the delivered artifacts (verification-queue item count, file names, and trigger behaviour match what was built)
Exhaustion classification is by identity (specific file/path/hash cited), not by a count claim or a name-substring match
